description_en: Queries the used quota, statistical window, and associated budget policies of a PolarDB gateway instance by budget dimension
description_zh: 按预算维度查询 PolarDB 网关实例的已用额度、统计窗口和关联预算策略
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-budget-usage --gw-cluster-id pc-123 --budget-dimension-type cluster --budget-dimension-ref-id ref-001 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBudgetUsage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway instance to query. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns InvalidPolarGatewayInstanceId.NotFound (404)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的网关实例 ID。此参数为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 InvalidPolarGatewayInstanceId.NotFound(404)
parameters.name: gw_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The budget dimension type. Valid values: Global (global budget), Consumer (consumer budget), and ConsumerGroup (consumer group budget)
parameters.help_zh: 预算维度类型。允许值：Global（全局预算）| Consumer（消费者预算）| ConsumerGroup（消费者组预算）
parameters.name: budget_dimension_type

parameters.help_en: The reference ID of the budget dimension. If BudgetDimensionType is set to Global, set this parameter to Global. If BudgetDimensionType is set to Consumer, set this parameter to the consumer ID returned by DescribeBudgetPolicies, such as consumer-xxx. If BudgetDimensionType is set to ConsumerGroup, set this parameter to the consumer group ID, such as cg-xxx
parameters.help_zh: 预算维度引用 ID。当 BudgetDimensionType 为 Global 时填 Global；为 Consumer 时填 DescribeBudgetPolicies 返回的 consumer ID（如 consumer-xxx）；为 ConsumerGroup 时填 consumer group ID（如 cg-xxx）
parameters.name: budget_dimension_ref_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the gateway instance resides
parameters.help_zh: 网关实例所在的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

AlertTriggered.description_en: Indicates whether a budget alert is triggered

DimensionRefId.description_en: The dimension reference ID of the current budget
DimensionRefId.description_zh: 当前预算的维度引用 ID

DimensionType.description_en: The dimension type of the current budget

Exceeded.description_en: Indicates whether the budget is exceeded

GmtCreated.description_en: The creation time of the budget usage record, in RFC 3339 UTC format
GmtCreated.description_zh: 预算使用记录的创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the budget usage record was last modified, in RFC 3339 UTC format
GmtModified.description_zh: 预算使用记录的最后修改时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

GwClusterId.description_en: The ID of the gateway instance

Policies.description_en: The list of associated budget policies

AlertThresholdPct.description_en: The usage percentage that triggers a budget alert
AlertThresholdPct.description_zh: 触发预算告警的使用比例

BudgetDimensionRefId.description_en: The reference ID of the budget dimension to which the policy applies
BudgetDimensionRefId.description_zh: 策略适用的预算维度引用 ID

BudgetDimensionType.description_en: The budget dimension type to which the policy applies
BudgetDimensionType.description_zh: 策略适用的预算维度类型

BudgetPoints.description_en: The number of budget points configured in the policy

BudgetPolicyId.description_en: The ID of the budget policy

ResetDayOfMonth.description_en: The day of the month on which the budget is reset. For example, 1 indicates the first day of each month
ResetDayOfMonth.description_zh: 每月重置预算的日序号，例如 1 表示每月 1 日

Status.description_en: The status of the budget policy

UsedPoints.description_en: The number of budget points used in the current statistical window
UsedPoints.description_zh: 当前统计窗口已使用的预算点数

WindowEndTime.description_en: The end time of the budget statistical window, in RFC 3339 UTC format
WindowEndTime.description_zh: 预算统计窗口的结束时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

WindowStartTime.description_en: The start time of the budget statistical window, in RFC 3339 UTC format
WindowStartTime.description_zh: 预算统计窗口的开始时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式
